inputs.label: Wave Race 64 ROM (USA, Rev A / v1.1)
inputs.help: Your own Wave Race 64 (USA) (Rev A) ROM as .z64, .n64 or .v64. Other versions and regions do not work.

steps.text: Open Wave Race 64 VR from Library > Unknown Sources. On the first screen, pick your ROM. The app loads the game from it.

notes: The release tag (v0.1.5) and the APK version (0.1.8) differ. The guide is in Portuguese.
